title: "01_cohort"
output: html_notebook

Cohort script for CLIF project testing temperature trajectories after CAR-T
Requires data_list to be loaded/validated from 00_setup

Cohort identification
 Inclusion criteria: age >= 18, dates 2018-2024, receipt of CAR-T

```{r inclusion}

hosp_incl <- 
  data_list$hospitalization %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    age_at_admission >= 18,
    !is.na(admission_dttm), !is.na(discharge_dttm),
    admission_dttm < discharge_dttm
  ) %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(admission_dttm <= end_date & start_date <= admission_dttm)

cart_product_incl <- 
  data_list$medication_admin_intermittent %>%
  dplyr::filter(med_group == "car_t") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cart_name = tolower(med_category),
    cart_group = dplyr::case_when(
      cart_name == "axicabtagene_ciloleucel"      ~ 1L,
      cart_name == "brexucabtagene_autoleucel"    ~ 2L,
      cart_name == "ciltacabtagene_autoleucel"    ~ 3L,
      cart_name == "idecabtagene_vicleucel"       ~ 4L,
      cart_name == "lisocabtagene_maraleucel"     ~ 5L,
      cart_name == "tisagenlecleucel"             ~ 6L,
      TRUE                                        ~ NA_integer_
    )) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(hospitalization_id, admin_dttm, cart_name, cart_group) %>%
  collect()

##Filter hospitalization based upon above inclusion criteria--------------------

hosp_incl_filter <- hosp_incl %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cart_product_incl, by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(hospitalization_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(hospitalization_id, admission_dttm)

## Set cart infusion at t0, 
## filter out hospitalizations before cart and after 30 days--------------------

cart_admin_t0 <- 
  cart_product_incl %>%
  dplyr::arrange(hospitalization_id, admin_dttm) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(hospitalization_id) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cart_t0 = admin_dttm) %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, cart_t0)                 

hosp_post_cart <- 
  hosp_incl_filter %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cart_admin_t0, by = "hospitalization_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(cart_t0),
    discharge_dttm >= cart_t0,
    admission_dttm <= cart_t0 + lubridate::days(30)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(index_admit = cart_t0 >= admission_dttm & 
                  cart_t0 <= discharge_dttm,
index_discharge_24h = index_admit & 
  (discharge_dttm < cart_t0 + lubridate::hours(24))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(patient_id, admission_dttm)

## Exclusion criteria: abnormal temp before cart, 
## death/discharge or missing 24 hr of temps -----------------------------------

hosp_post_cart_excl <- 
  hosp_post_cart %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!any(index_discharge_24h, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

temp <- 
  data_list$vitals %>%
  dplyr::filter(vital_category == "temp_c") %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, temp_c = vital_value) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    hosp_post_cart_excl %>%
      dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0, index_admit),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(index_admit) %>%
  collect() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pre_norm_temp = any(
      recorded_dttm >= (cart_t0 - lubridate::hours(12)) &
      recorded_dttm <  cart_t0 &
      !is.na(temp_c) &
      temp_c >= 35 & temp_c < 38,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    post_24h_temp = any(
      recorded_dttm >= cart_t0 + lubridate::hours(24),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(temp_pass = pre_norm_temp & post_24h_temp) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(temp_pass = any(temp_pass, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

hosp_post_cart_final <- 
  hosp_post_cart_excl %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    temp %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, temp_pass),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(temp_pass) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(patient_id, admission_dttm)

```

Counts for exclusion flow diagram

```{r exclusions}

# 1) n adult patients hospitalized 2018-2024
n_hosp_total <-
  hosp_incl %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id) %>%
  nrow()

# 2) patients who did not receive cart
n_no_cart <-
  hosp_incl %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id) %>%
  dplyr::anti_join(cart_product_incl %>% inner_join(hosp_incl) %>% 
  fselect(patient_id, hospitalization_id) %>% 
  funique(), dplyr::distinct(patient_id), by = "patient_id") %>%
  nrow()

# 3) n patients who were hospitalized AND had CAR-T
n_pts_incl <-
  hosp_incl_filter %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id) %>%
  nrow()

# 4) post-CAR-T exclusions (patient-level)
n_early_discharge <-
  hosp_post_cart %>%
  dplyr::filter(index_admit, index_discharge_24h) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id) %>%
  nrow()

n_index_admit <-
  hosp_post_cart %>%
  dplyr::filter(index_admit) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id) %>%
  nrow()

n_index_temp <-
  temp %>%                      
  dplyr::filter(temp_pass) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id) %>%
  nrow()

n_temp_fail <- n_index_admit - n_index_temp

# 5) final cohort size (patients who pass all criteria)
n_final <-
  hosp_post_cart_final %>%            
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id) %>%
  nrow()

excl_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  step = c(
    "N patients hospitalized 2018-2024",         
    "N patients who did not receive CAR-T",
    "N patients meeting all inclusion criteria",
    "N patients discharged or deceased <72 hours post CAR-T",
    "N patients without sufficient temp data",
    "N patients meeting all inclusion and exclusion criteria"
  ),
  n = c(
    n_hosp_total,
    n_no_cart,
    n_pts_incl, 
    n_early_discharge,
    n_temp_fail,
    n_final
  ))

excl_summary_path <- 
  file.path(
  project_location,
  "final_output",
  paste0("excl_summary_", today, ".csv")
)

data.table::fwrite(excl_summary, excl_summary_path)

rm(hosp_incl, cart_product_incl, hosp_incl_filter, hosp_post_cart, 
   hosp_post_cart_excl, excl_summary, excl_summary_path, n_hosp_total, 
   n_no_cart, n_pts_incl, n_early_discharge, n_index_admit, n_index_temp, 
   n_temp_fail, n_final)

gc()
      
```

```{r cohort assemble}
      dplyr::select(patient_id, 
                    race_category,

                    death_dttm) %>%

cohort <- 
  hosp_post_cart_final %>%

select(
```

Outcomes
 -Index hospital LOS
 -readmit within 30 days
 -death within 30 days
 -death within 90 days

```{r outcomes}

cohort <- cohort %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  mutate(
    index_hospital_LOS = if_else(
      cart_t0 >= admission_dttm & cart_t0 <= discharge_dttm,
      as.numeric(difftime(discharge_dttm, admission_dttm, units = "days")),
      NA_real_),
    death_30d = as.integer(
      !is.na(death_dttm) &
      death_dttm >= cart_t0 &
      death_dttm <= cart_t0 + lubridate::days(30)),
    death_90d = as.integer(
      !is.na(death_dttm) &
      death_dttm >= cart_t0 &
      death_dttm <= cart_t0 + lubridate::days(90)),
    readmit_30d = as.integer(dplyr::n_distinct(hospitalization_id) > 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

Medications

```{r medications}

norm_medcat <- function(x) tolower(trimws(x))

##Toci, anakinra, acetaminophen
###Tocilizumab (time-to-first, total doses within 30d)
toci <- data_list$medication_admin_intermittent %>%
  dplyr::filter(med_category == "tocilizumab") %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, admin_dttm) %>%
  collect() %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cohort %>% 
      dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(admin_dttm),
    admin_dttm >= cart_t0,
    admin_dttm <= cart_t0 + lubridate::days(30)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    toci_first_admin = min(admin_dttm, na.rm = TRUE),
    toci_n_doses_30d   = dplyr::n(),
    toci_time_until  = as.numeric(difftime(min(admin_dttm, na.rm = TRUE),
                                           min(cart_t0, na.rm = TRUE),
                                           units = "hours")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, toci_time_until, toci_n_doses_30d)

###Anakinra (time-to-first, total doses within 30d)
anakinra <- data_list$medication_admin_intermittent %>%
  dplyr::filter(med_category == "anakinra") %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, admin_dttm) %>%
  dplyr::collect() %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cohort %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(admin_dttm),
    admin_dttm >= cart_t0,
    admin_dttm <= cart_t0 + lubridate::days(30)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    anakinra_first_admin = min(admin_dttm, na.rm = TRUE),
    anakinra_n_doses_30d   = dplyr::n(),
    anakinra_time_until  = as.numeric(difftime(min(admin_dttm, na.rm = TRUE),
                                               min(cart_t0, na.rm = TRUE),
                                               units = "hours")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, anakinra_time_until, anakinra_n_doses_30d)

###Acetaminophen (total doses, cumulative doses within 72 hours after CART)
apap <- 
data_list$medication_admin_intermittent %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    med_category == "acetaminophen") %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, admin_dttm, med_dose, med_dose_unit) %>%
  collect() %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cohort %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0),
    by = "hospitalization_id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(admin_dttm),
    admin_dttm >= cart_t0,
    admin_dttm <= cart_t0 + lubridate::hours(72)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    apap_n_doses_72h       = dplyr::n(),
    apap_cum_dose_72h = sum(med_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cohort <- 
cohort %>%
  dplyr::left_join(apap,     by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(toci,     by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(anakinra, by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    toci_n_doses_30d      = tidyr::replace_na(toci_n_doses_30d, 0L),
    anakinra_n_doses_30d  = tidyr::replace_na(anakinra_n_doses_30d, 0L),
    apap_n_doses_72h          = tidyr::replace_na(apap_n_doses_72h, 0L),           
    apap_cum_dose_72h   = tidyr::replace_na(apap_cum_dose_72h, 0)   
  )

rm(toci, anakinra, apap)

## Steroids
# This code calculates how many days after cart a patient received steroids at a 
# dose usually used to treat CRS and/or ICANs.
steroid_map <- tibble::tibble(
  med_category = c("dexamethasone","betamethasone","methylprednisolone","prednisone","prednisolone","hydrocortisone"),
  dex_factor   = c(1.0000,        1.2500,         0.1875,              0.1500,      0.1500,       0.0375)
)

weight <- 
  data_list$vitals %>%
  dplyr::filter(vital_category == "weight_kg") %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, recorded_dttm, weight_kg = vital_value) %>%
  collect() %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cohort %>% dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, admission_dttm),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(recorded_dttm), recorded_dttm >= admission_dttm) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(hospitalization_id) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = recorded_dttm, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, weight_kg)

steroid_admin <- 
  data_list$medication_admin_intermittent %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(med_dose),
    med_category %in% steroid_map$med_category,
    med_dose_unit %in% c("mg", "mg/kg")
  ) %>%
  collect() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    med_dose_unit = dplyr::if_else(med_dose_unit == "mg/kg/day", "mg/kg", med_dose_unit)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, 
                admin_dttm, 
                med_category, 
                med_dose, 
                med_dose_unit) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cohort %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(admin_dttm),
    admin_dttm >= cart_t0,
    admin_dttm <= cart_t0 + lubridate::days(30)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(weight, by = "hospitalization_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    steroid_dose_mg = dplyr::if_else(
      med_dose_unit == "mg", med_dose, med_dose * weight_kg
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(steroid_dose_mg)) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id, admin_dttm, med_category, steroid_dose_mg)

steroid_dex <- 
  steroid_admin %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(steroid_map, by = "med_category") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dex_mg_equivalent = steroid_dose_mg * dex_factor,
    admin_date        = as.Date(admin_dttm)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id, hospitalization_id, admin_date) %>%        
  dplyr::summarise(
    daily_dex_mg = sum(dex_mg_equivalent, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%                                         
  dplyr::summarise(
    steroid_days_30d = as.integer(sum(daily_dex_mg >= 10, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cohort <-
  cohort %>%
  dplyr::left_join(steroid_dex, by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(steroid_days_30d = tidyr::replace_na(steroid_days_30d, 0L))

rm(steroid_map, weight, steroid_admin, steroid_dex)

#EASIX severity scores----------------------------------------------------------

safe_div  <- function(num, den) ifelse(!is.na(num) & !is.na(den) & den > 0, num / den, NA_real_)
safe_log2 <- function(x) ifelse(!is.na(x) & x > 0, log2(x), NA_real_)

thr_easix    <- 4.6
thr_ferritin <- 321   # ng/mL
thr_crp      <- 21    # mg/L

# 1) Pull labs -12h and +12 from CART
lab_window <- data_list$labs %>%
  dplyr::rename(lab_time = lab_result_dttm) %>%
  dplyr::filter(lab_category %in% c("ldh", "creatinine", "platelet_count", "crp", "ferritin", "lymphocytes_absolute", "wbc")) %>%
  collect() %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cohort %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(lab_time),
    lab_time >= cart_t0 - lubridate::hours(12),
    lab_time <= cart_t0 + lubridate::hours(12)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(hospitalization_id, lab_category) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(lab_time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, lab_category, lab_value_numeric)

lab_window_wide <- lab_window %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = lab_category, values_from = lab_value_numeric)

cohort <- cohort %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    lab_window_wide %>%
      dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, wbc, lymphocytes_absolute) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        wbc_infusion      = wbc,                   
        lymph_abs_infusion = lymphocytes_absolute  
      ),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  )
  
# 2) Calculate scores
scores <- lab_window_wide %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cohort %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    easix        = safe_div(creatinine * ldh, platelet_count),
    m_easix      = safe_div(crp * ldh,        platelet_count),
    s_easix      = safe_div(ldh,              platelet_count),
    log2_easix   = safe_log2(easix),
    log2_m_easix = safe_log2(m_easix),
    log2_s_easix = safe_log2(s_easix)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient_id,
    easix, log2_easix,
    m_easix, log2_m_easix,
    s_easix, log2_s_easix,
    ferritin, crp
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    easix_f_cat = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(easix) & easix > thr_easix ~ "High",
      !is.na(easix) & easix <= thr_easix & !is.na(ferritin) & ferritin > thr_ferritin ~ "Intermediate",
      !is.na(easix) & easix <= thr_easix & !is.na(ferritin) & ferritin <= thr_ferritin ~ "Low",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    easix_fc_cat = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(ferritin) & ferritin > thr_ferritin ~ "High",
      !is.na(ferritin) & ferritin <= thr_ferritin &
        ( (!is.na(easix) & easix > thr_easix) | (!is.na(crp) & crp > thr_crp) ) ~ "Intermediate",
      !is.na(ferritin) & ferritin <= thr_ferritin &
        (!is.na(easix) & easix <= thr_easix) &
        (!is.na(crp)   & crp   <= thr_crp) ~ "Low",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    easix_f_cat  = factor(easix_f_cat,  levels = c("Low","Intermediate","High"), ordered = TRUE),
    easix_fc_cat = factor(easix_fc_cat, levels = c("Low","Intermediate","High"), ordered = TRUE)
  )

cohort <- cohort %>%
  dplyr::left_join(scores, by = "patient_id")

abx_list <- c(
  "amikacin","aztreonam","cefepime","cefiderocol","ceftaroline","ceftazidime",
  "ceftazidime_avibactam","ceftazidime_clavulanate","ceftolozane_tazobactam",
  "colistin","dalbavancin","daptomycin","doripenem","ertapenem","fidaxomicin",
  "gentamicin","imipenem","imipenem_relebactam","linezolid","meropenem",
  "meropenem_vaborbactam","metronidazole","piperacillin_tazobactam","tedizolid",
  "telavancin","tigecycline","tobramycin","vancomycin"
)

abx <- data_list$medication_admin_intermittent %>%
  dplyr::select(hospitalization_id, med_group, med_category, admin_dttm) %>%
  dplyr::filter(med_group == 'CMS_sepsis_qualifying_antibiotics') %>%
  collect() %>%
  dplyr::filter(med_category %in% abx_list) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    cohort %>% dplyr::select(patient_id, hospitalization_id, cart_t0),
    by = "hospitalization_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(admin_dttm),
    admin_dttm >= cart_t0,
    admin_dttm <= cart_t0 + lubridate::days(30)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(admin_date = as.Date(admin_dttm)) %>%            
  dplyr::distinct(patient_id, admin_date) %>%                    
  dplyr::count(patient_id, name = "abx_30d")

cohort <- cohort %>%
  dplyr::left_join(blood_cx, by = "hospitalization_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(abx,      by = "patient_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    bx_positive_30d = tidyr::replace_na(bx_positive_30d, 0L),
    abx_30d         = tidyr::replace_na(abx_30d,         0L)
  )


rm(norm_medcat, safe_div, safe_log2, thr_easix, thr_ferritin, thr_crp, lab_window, lab_window_wide, scores,
  abx_list, abx)
gc()

```

```{r final cleanup}
  file.path(
  project_location, "intermediate_output",
  paste0("cohort_", institution, "_", today, ".csv")
)

data.table::fwrite(cohort, cohort_path)
```
